stories.headline: AWS and NVIDIA to Deliver 2 Million Additional GPUs and Next-Generation Infrastructure for Agentic and Physical AI
stories.new_information: AWS and NVIDIA to Deliver 2 Million Additional GPUs and Next-Generation Infrastructure for Agentic and Physical AI. Building on already-rapid customer adoption of NVIDIA-accelerated compute on AWS, the companies plan to deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS’s global infrastructure and deepen their work together across AI factories, CPUs, networking, open models, data processing and robotics, delivering co-engineered AI solutions that enable customers to accelerate AI development and deployment at unprecedented scale.
stories.impact_chain: Direct: AI Models/Applications, Physical AI / Robotics, Compute, HBM/Memory, Networking/Optical, Data Centers. Second-order: Power/Electrical, Cooling.

evidence_sources.title: AWS and NVIDIA to Deliver 2 Million Additional GPUs and Next-Generation Infrastructure for Agentic and Physical AI

facts: AWS and NVIDIA to Deliver 2 Million Additional GPUs and Next-Generation Infrastructure for Agentic and Physical AI

Building on already-rapid customer adoption of NVIDIA-accelerated compute on AWS, the companies plan to deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS’s global infrastructure and deepen their work together across AI factories, CPUs, networking, open models, data processing and robotics, delivering co-engineered AI solutions that enable customers to accelerate AI development and deployment at unprecedented scale.

As part of the expanded collaboration, the companies are working to: Deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS’s global infrastructure in 2027-2028 Bring NVIDIA Vera CPU‑based infrastructure to AWS Extend NVIDIA NVLink Fusion™ with custom NVIDIA high‑bandwidth memory (NVHBM) Build AI factories for the U.S.

stories.headline: NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX Now in Full Production With World-Class Speed for Agentic AI
stories.new_information: For providers serving latency-sensitive, high-volume inference workloads, NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX provides a path to deploy differentiated compute in proven rack-scale systems. An extension of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, Groq 3 LPX delivers a major boost in AI inference by enabling ultrafast token generation for highly responsive agentic systems.
stories.impact_chain: Direct: AI Models/Applications, Compute. Second-order: HBM/Memory, Foundry/Advanced Packaging.

evidence_sources.title: NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX Now in Full Production With World-Class Speed for Agentic AI

facts: For providers serving latency-sensitive, high-volume inference workloads, NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX provides a path to deploy differentiated compute in proven rack-scale systems.
An extension of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, Groq 3 LPX delivers a major boost in AI inference by enabling ultrafast token generation for highly responsive agentic systems.

It delivered a record 3,400 output tokens per second in Artificial Analysis benchmarking running Gemma 4 31B, an open source agentic model, with a 100,000-token context critical for agentic systems — the fastest performance ever recorded for the model.

About MediaTek MediaTek (TWSE: 2454) is a global leader in fabless semiconductor design, powering AI from the edge to the cloud.

methodology.high_conviction_boundary: Biotech Radar may include pre-revenue or binary development-stage companies. Radar status and score never qualify a company for long-term High Conviction.
methodology.horizon: Potentially valuation-changing catalysts expected within the next 183 days (approximately six months).
methodology.opportunity_score_policy: Opportunity Score is normalized over available weighted inputs. Missing inputs are excluded, never treated as zero, and Data Completeness must be reviewed with the score.
methodology.evidence_gate: Scientific Evidence below 18/30 cannot be High Conviction. High Conviction additionally requires Scientific Evidence of at least 24/30, 75% completeness, and High confidence.
methodology.integrity_gate: Explicit credibility or data-integrity concerns cap evidence confidence at Low.
methodology.news_boundary: Biotech News is retained as dated confirming, mixed, or contradicting evidence. News importance never sets a Radar factor or Opportunity Score.
methodology.market_data_policy: XBI price trend supplies up to 10 of 15 Sector Trend points; security price/volume technicals supply up to 5 of 10 Timing & Technicals points. Phase 5B supplies Expectation Gap from current valuation, run-up, analyst-revision and short-interest inputs. Options IV and advanced capital-flow data remain excluded.
methodology.binary_risk: Low / Moderate / High / Extreme uses available evidence uncertainty and catalyst magnitude; missing company valuation sensitivity or portfolio dependence prevents a Low classification.
methodology.scope_note: V1 scores the existing curated Company → Drug/Program → Indication → Catalyst set. Unavailable valuation, analyst, short-interest, trial, portfolio-dependence, options-IV and advanced capital-flow inputs remain missing.

ai_methodology.early_discovery_policy: A company may enter Radar from source-backed thesis evidence about technology, capability, capacity, customer exposure, supply-chain position, or competitive position. Orders, backlog, revenue, and earnings confirmation are not prerequisites.
ai_methodology.high_conviction_boundary: Radar identifies potential future beneficiaries; its Trend Strength, Opportunity Score, and rank never qualify a company for long-term High Conviction.
ai_methodology.trend_strength_policy: Trend Strength uses available Structural, Demand, Bottleneck and Earnings factors. Missing factors are excluded, not scored as zero.
ai_methodology.opportunity_score_policy: Opportunity Score requires current Expectation Gap/Valuation and trend-specific Market Confirmation evidence. Missing inputs remain missing rather than becoming zero.
ai_methodology.expectation_gap_policy: Expectation Gap / Valuation aggregates evidence-supported public beneficiaries using Nasdaq valuation, analyst-consensus, estimate-revision and short-interest inputs plus the shared market layer's recent price run-up. At least two input groups are required.
ai_methodology.market_confirmation_policy: Market Confirmation aggregates price trend and relative strength versus QQQ across evidence-supported public beneficiaries; missing security data remains missing.
ai_methodology.physical_ai_policy: Demos and pilots cannot establish scaled or mass adoption. A3+ requires real commercial deployment evidence; A4+ requires quantified scale.

result.clinical_evidence: The amended BLA was accepted and the FDA recommendation was based on the Phase 3 program; the v1 cutoff source set does not reproduce all endpoint tables.
result.previous_results: A Phase 3 regulatory package supported the accepted amended BLA. No post-July 31 outcome information is used.
result.regulatory_status: FDA PDUFA date of August 5, 2026, as disclosed by July 31, 2026.
result.commercial_potential: A fifth approved product could broaden Moderna's respiratory franchise, but the v1 case has no independently verified product-level forecast.
result.positioning: Missing verified cutoff-date positioning and technical data.
result.risks: Regulatory rejection or delay, label restrictions, competitive flu vaccines and commercial execution.
result.watch_next: FDA decision on August 5, 2026; outcome deliberately excluded from the retrospective input set.

expectation.rationale: No current expectation/valuation record is connected.

result.upcoming_catalyst: FDA PDUFA decision for mFLUSIVA — August 5, 2026
result.binary_risk_rationale: Evidence uncertainty is 27/30; catalyst magnitude is 14/25. Verified company valuation sensitivity and portfolio dependence are missing, so risk cannot be classified Low.
result.company_sensitivity: Missing: no verified program-level valuation sensitivity is connected.
result.portfolio_dependence: Missing: no verified portfolio-dependence measure is connected.

evidence_gate.rule: Scientific Evidence below 18/30 cannot be High Conviction; High Conviction also requires at least 75% completeness and High confidence.

evidence_integrity_gate.rule: Explicit credibility or data-integrity concerns cap confidence at Low.

score_components.rationale: An accepted BLA backed by Phase 3 evidence is strong, but full endpoint detail is not present in the connected cutoff sources.

score_components.label: Catalyst Impact / Company Sensitivity
score_components.rationale: An FDA approval decision is a maximum-importance valuation catalyst. Portfolio expansion is material, but a verified product forecast is missing. Verified program-level valuation sensitivity and portfolio dependence are missing.

missing_fields: Verified valuation, analyst, run-up, and positioning inputs

methodology.relative_strength: Stock return minus benchmark return in percentage points for the same horizon.
methodology.entry_timing_inputs: Adds MA5/10, 42/63-session close ranges, MA compression, volume contraction/up-down volume, prior-60-session close resistance, and close-based support. Rules and source dates are retained in each record.
methodology.expectation_state: Requires at least two input groups. Underpriced, Fairly Priced, and Crowded / Priced In use transparent target-upside, forward-P/E, price-run-up, estimate-revision, and positioning signals; missing inputs remain null.
methodology.price_run_up: Uses existing 1M/3M/6M close-to-close returns as a recent pre-event proxy unless a verified event-specific anchor is available.
methodology.missing_data: Unavailable fields remain null; prior successful security records may be retained with data_status=stale.

methodology.base: A 63-session close range <=25%, or 42-session close range <=20%; this is a price-range screen, not a discretionary chart-pattern claim.
methodology.resistance: Highest close in the 60 sessions ending five sessions before the current close.
methodology.invalidation: Closest available support below price from the detected base low and MA50; omitted when neither is below price.
methodology.decline_and_bottom: Major-decline context uses the current close versus the trailing 252-session high; distance from the bottom uses the trailing 63-session low.
methodology.volume: Last-10-session average versus the preceding 20 sessions; accumulation compares up-day and down-day volume over 20 sessions.

diagnostics.primary_bottleneck_fixed: Company discovery previously required an explicit company mention in a current news event; active themes now scan and validate a general listed-company profile universe.
diagnostics.remaining_source_constraint: Discovery breadth depends on the industry/product metadata present in the listed-company source; missing profile detail remains missing.

policy.no_manual_ticker_insertion: Stock discovery scans source-backed company profiles in a general listed-company universe using category capability rules, not a theme-specific ticker list.
policy.size_diversity: Market capitalization is context only. It never raises relevance; diversity selection prevents equally credible results from being dominated by mega caps.
policy.discovery_not_scoring: Reasoning signals create research candidates only; existing Radar scoring remains unchanged.
policy.early_entry_policy: Orders, backlog, guidance, customers, and revenue are not required for Radar entry when source-backed thesis evidence establishes a logical beneficiary connection.
policy.evidence_separation: Thesis Evidence explains why a company may benefit; Confirmation Evidence records commercial proof without replacing the thesis.
policy.missing_data: Unresolved company identity remains unresolved and is not converted into a ticker.

methodology.scope: Focused output from broad public-company profile discovery and evidence-derived AI themes; this is not a generic stock screener.
methodology.ai_flow: Evidence → structured reasoning → theme discovery → beneficiary discovery → stock discovery → Radar.
methodology.no_manual_ticker_insertion: Reasoning-driven stocks come from evidence identities or category-validated profiles in a general listed-company universe, not manually added theme tickers.
methodology.candidate_is_not_conviction: Discovery is research coverage only and cannot pass any High-Conviction gate.
methodology.biotech_path: Therapeutic trend → program → company → catalyst when a current Radar record exists; related modality matches remain unverified discovery candidates.

methodology.missing_policy: Available weights renormalize; absent, stale or incomparable inputs are not zero.
methodology.source: Nasdaq annual reported financial statements; fiscal dates are not publication dates.
limitations: Monetary scale not declared: raw provider values retained; no absolute USD amounts inferred.
Annual financial ratios, not quarterly estimates or forecasts.
Cash runway is a historical burn proxy, not management guidance.
No verified segment earnings sensitivity, lead-asset dependence, or complete pipeline census is assumed.

methodology.strategy: Major Decline → Bottoming → Early Reversal → Entry Zone, followed by a separate credible-catalyst check.
methodology.selection_principle: Early Technical Reversal + Credible Catalyst = Strong Swing Trade Opportunity
methodology.missing_data_policy: Missing values remain missing and cannot satisfy either selection step.
methodology.independence: This engine does not use High-Conviction classification and does not modify Radar or Watchlist outputs.

reasoning: Step 1 screens independently for a major decline, stabilization near a recent low, and an early reversal or entry-zone structure. Extended stocks are rejected.
Step 2 runs only after the technical screen and requires a dated, source-backed clinical, regulatory, corporate, commercial, or industry catalyst.
Early Reversal and Entry Zone rank ahead of Bottoming and Breakout because the strategy seeks improving setups before a substantial run-up.
take_home_messages: 21 stocks passed the technical-first screen; 16 also had a credible connected catalyst.
Current selected candidates: DUKR, BEAM, NTLA, META.
